evidence.indexFingerprintMethod: SHA-256 of RAW subprocess stdout bytes from git ls-files --stage -z, cwd=repository. No decoding, newline rewriting, sorting or hashing of the .git/index file.
evidence.method: One final independent combined source/security/logic review of the staged diff, plus bounded inspection of existing static screenshots. Not a rerun of /critique or a polishing loop.
evidence.stagedDiffReview: All staged textual diffs were read per file without display truncation; image/font binaries were fingerprinted and checked separately. All 1209 added src lines were included in source review. Hashing an unchanged file is not a claim to have audited its entire implementation.
evidence.sourceFingerprintMethod: SHA-256 of raw bytes for every on-disk file recursively under frontend/documentflow-web/src and frontend/documentflow-web/public, including .gitattributes, provenance and licenses. sourceFingerprints are worktree raw bytes; stagedSourceFingerprints independently hash git show :path raw blobs.

preservedFunctions.status: source preservation checked; runtime behavior not certified

reviewedBindings.result: Existing documents/search/dashboard/upload/users/catalogs/password routes remain reachable; admin entries remain role-gated and App Protected admin is unchanged. logout is still the AuthProvider callback. Header search uses URLSearchParams and navigate to the actual text-search route; Ctrl/Meta+K listener has cleanup. Account menu uses native details/summary. Open/authenticated menu and keyboard flow were source-reviewed only.

Polling, abort/epoch handling, search, all previous filters, sorting, archive, date guard, CSV export and pagination callbacks preserved. Status select replaced by aria-pressed filter buttons invoking the same setFilter. Existing record values remain React text; returnTo and manual-review links are carried into the new table.

File selection and added drop handler both use receiveFiles; validateFile/validateBatch, 20-file/20-MiB/100-MiB limits, append/replace confirmation, upload-in-progress guard, navigation guard, retry, duplicate links, polling and recent IDs are retained. Drop does not start upload; submit still calls existing uploadBatch. New progress is final-status count, not fabricated OCR percentage.

Text/semantic modes, explicit semantic-unavailable fallback, filters, counterparties, errors/retry, pagination and result data preserved. New row action points to the same document with returnTo, adding manual-review anchor only for eligible NeedsReview records.

Catalog CRUD, approval, destructive confirmation, system-item guards, tabs/keyboard handlers and reindex handlers retained. aiDrafts and managedKinds are complementary partitions, so no kind is omitted. Automatic drafts retain red warning/outline; activation still requires existing admin approval flow. Counts derive from loaded records, not mock values.

Action handlers/guards, returnTo validation, review context, polling, archive/restore, reprocess/retry, lifecycle, next-review and cinema/Escape/focus restoration logic unchanged. Layout retains keyed DocumentReviewForm, DocumentPreview and DocumentAssignment; assignment moves into the right column as a sibling section, not inside the review form. Ancillary relations/duplicates/diagnostics/history remain present.

Unchanged component retains separate document version and draft revision, stale/emergency recovery, conflict display, guard, explicit draft save and confirmation controls. New CSS retains hidden tab semantics, validity/focus indicators and visible recovery content; no silent overwrite introduced by the layout diff.

Existing secondary page functionality remains routed; login/dashboard diffs change presentation copy only, other secondary page sources unchanged. Shared Sovereign CSS styles these pages; contact-sheet visibility is not end-to-end evidence.

securityReview.status: No confirmed new security defect in the reviewed staged changes
securityReview.basis: Manual review of all staged source additions/removals and relevant existing guards; previous lexical scan context is supplementary, not a proof.
observations: New visible values remain escaped React children/attributes. No new innerHTML/dangerouslySetInnerHTML, eval/exec, shell invocation, SQL construction, unsafe deserialization, credential literal or outbound service introduced in the source diff.
Header query is encoded through URLSearchParams into a fixed local route; new search result document URLs retain encodeURIComponent. No user-controlled external navigation endpoint added.
New drag/drop path does not bypass file/batch validation or start network submission; existing API/auth/session/hooks/types were verified unchanged against HEAD.
Roles are not inferred from the visual shell: existing Protected admin gate remains unchanged. Hiding admin menu is not claimed as server authorization verification.

SVG shapes in Icon.tsx are local constant path data rendered by createElement, not injected HTML. Font declarations point to local public files; remote reference CDNs are not imported into the added runtime code.

verdict.scope: The exact reviewed staged index and fingerprinted frontend/public content, source/static-review only; not unconditional production or end-to-end acceptance.
verdict.summary: В проверенном staged diff и ограниченном наборе статических изображений новых подтверждённых security/logic/material defects не обнаружено. Перенос согласуется с закреплённым Stitch Sovereign; ship разрешён только в этом явно ограниченном scope.
verdict.rule: Any confirmed security, logic or material issue would require disposition=fix and passed=false. Unverified areas are recorded as unverified, never as passes.

Live interactions: поиск, фильтры, CSV, пагинация, drag/drop, upload/retry/duplicate/polling, подтверждение, draft/CAS/recovery, назначение, catalog approval/reindex, login/password/users.
scopeNotes: Existing 18 captures show real component SSR initial/loading/empty states only; no server/API/DB, mocked responses or hydration effects were executed in this review. Their existence does not establish real authenticated sessions or successful API operations.

Exactly four current screenshots were inspected in detail plus one contact sheet containing all 18 states. The remaining states were viewed only at contact-sheet scale; per-image metadata/hashes/dimensions are not equivalent to detailed visual inspection.
document-loading names are intentional. Absence of API-populated content is expected, not a broken capture and not a demand to manufacture document data.

No new capture or live render was generated; capture metadata is pre-existing evidence. Hashes bind artifacts available now, not an independently witnessed capture process or proof of source-to-render provenance.
All changed source diffs were reviewed, not the entire backend or every unchanged source implementation. A clean manual/lexical review is not an exhaustive security guarantee.
Build success is reported from delegation context only. Tests/build/detector/servers/API/DB were expressly not run here; absence of tests is not a finding.
DESIGN.md and design sidecar are the next documenter gate. The finished-product acceptance contract is not marked fully passed by this report.
